name: Tulive Developers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1962, Tulive Developers Ltd is in real estate and construction business
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Tulive's parent company is G K Shetty Builders. Company is in the construction of IT parks, 5 Star Hotels, Residential Homes, Commercial Complexes and National Infrastructure. Company is a partner in the partnership firms viz., Tulive Estate and Tulive Builders

cons: Stock is trading at 3.65 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.19% over last 3 years.
